mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) may potentiate cyclobenzaprine's CNS depression and increase risk of orthostatic hypotension and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly; ensure adequate potassium and magnesium supplementation if concurrent use is necessary; counsel patient on fall risk and orthostatic precautions.
